name: Neev: brick kiln energy efficiency to cut air pollution (Ambitious Impact, 2026 idea report)
summary: Ambitious Impact's 2025 estimate for a new charity training brick kiln owners and operators in northern India to run zigzag kilns more efficiently, cutting the fine particles and sulphur dioxide that harm people's health. The idea Neev was founded to run (AIM's 2026 cohort). A re-implementation of the health tab of AIM's spreadsheet, traced from its final cost per DALY averted in Uttar Pradesh ($315). The climate benefit AIM estimates on a separate tab (about $2 per tonne of CO2) is left out; at the site's climate rates it would add about 3% at the defaults, and if added its tonnes would carry an air_pollution_weight of 0, since the health tab already counts the kilns' smoke.

rows.label: Staff pay as a share of program cost
rows.explainer: Default for programs where staff deliver the help themselves (treatment, counselling, coaching, outreach): staff pay is about half the cost. Our judgment; we haven't seen this program's breakdown.

rows.label: Pay gap versus comparable jobs elsewhere
rows.explainer: Health workers and field staff at nonprofits often earn somewhat less than in comparable jobs. Our judgment.

rows.label: Salary forgone by staff per dollar of cost (in-kind donation)
Share of the full cost paid in cash
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost, and staff get their share of the outcome. Off, this is 100%.

rows.label: DALYs averted per dollar
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, times the share of the full cost paid in cash (staff's forgone pay is the rest).

native.unit: $ per DALY averted (Uttar Pradesh, India, final result)
